race.comment: DANCING STORM (2) is yet to break through from three runs in Melbourne but should be hitting his straps now back in his home state. Boasts a strong record over this track and trip and is drawn to get all the favours. Will relish a strong tempo and will take plenty of holding out late. THE STALKER (1) went too fast for his own good last start but showed plenty of grit in the lane to hold down second. Will look to lead again and if he can steal a couple cheapies through the middle he'll be tough to reel in late. INVERTATIONAL (10) will appreciate the anticipated tempo and if the gaps appear can pounce on them late. THE COSMIC ONE (6) rode the speed before putting the race to bed here two weeks ago with a dominant win. Still improving and is in the mix. AUTUMN FROST (4) is handy gelding resuming for the Jolly camp. Will give himself every chance on speed but might just lack a fitness edge late.
